# Security policy

## Reporting

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately to the project maintainer before public disclosure. Include the affected component, exact source version, reproduction steps, expected impact, and any proposed mitigation.

Do not include private keys, seed phrases, API keys, scorer credentials, or unrelated personal data. Do not move or retain user or protocol funds while testing.

## Supported candidate

The active review target is the Revision 7.2 precompilation source candidate:

- Identity Registry V1.0.1
- LABR V4.0.0
- Exchange V7.0.0
- LaborVote V9.1.1
- Registration V6.1.1
- Proposal Text Policy V1.0.1
- Governance V15.1.1

Revision 7.2 is not compiled or deployed. Revision 6 and historical deployments are preserved as superseded evidence only.

## Highest-priority review areas

- equal-per-eligible-holder dividend accounting
- permanent score-15 identity authorization and replay protection
- identity gating of buys, sells, dividend accrual, and claims
- LABR, Exchange, and Identity Registry launch-binding cycle
- fixed wallet, transaction, and cooldown rules
- Registration and LaborVote minter finalization
- Governance thresholds, proposal-state transitions, recipient restrictions, and Aragon permission handling

## Disclosure status

No independent audit claim should be inferred from source checks, compilation, explorer verification, or internal tests. Public disclosure should be coordinated after evidence is preserved and affected participants can be warned safely.
